neighbours.label: the continuation piece of a proper name the tokenizer splits in two or more (Weg|mans, Bel|kin, Lip|kin, Daw|kins, Burk|ina, Kro|ger, Net|gear); a single-token name in the same slot is silent
fire: Every Sunday my aunt drives to Wegmans for the rotisserie chicken.
The wireless keyboard from Belkin stopped pairing after the update.
Dr Lipkin presented the virus sequencing results on the first morning.
Richard Dawkins debated the bishop in a packed Oxford hall.
The cotton harvest in Burkina Faso was poor this year because the rains came late.
We switched to Kroger when the local shop closed.
The Hodgkin lymphoma trial recruited patients from twelve hospitals.
A Netgear switch in the basement connects the two buildings.
quiet: Every Sunday my aunt drives to Costco for the rotisserie chicken.
The wireless keyboard from Apple stopped pairing after the update.
Dr Perkins presented the virus sequencing results on the first morning.
Richard Jenkins debated the bishop in a packed Oxford hall.
The cotton harvest in Mali was poor this year because the rains came late.
We switched to Walmart when the local shop closed.
The lymphoma trial recruited patients from twelve hospitals.
A Cisco switch in the basement connects the two buildings.

notes: Probe: Weg|mans 0.988, Bel|kin 0.882, G|ook|in 0.867, weak lens|ing 0.682, Burk|ina 0.490. The same sentences with Walmart, Hopkins, Smith, Ghana (single tokens) 0.015-0.040. Splits of every test name were checked with the tokenizer.
